title: Question 29
passage:
Did you mean the blank checklist or the one we completed yesterday?
A. Send me the one with our notes already on it. B. There are extra pens in the drawer. C. It should take about ten minutes to fill out.
passageZh:
你指的是空白檢查表，還是我們昨天填好的那份？
A. 請把上面已寫有我們筆記的那份寄給我。 B. 抽屜裡還有備用的筆。 C. 填完應該需要十分鐘左右。
